name: Fatal Frontier 1869
storyline:
In 1869, whispers of gold spread across the frozen wilderness of Alaska, drawing desperate pioneers into a land that rewards few and buries many.

Among them, you arrive with little more than a pickaxe and a claim, chasing the promise of fortune. But the frontier is unforgiving - storms roll in without warning, predators stalk the night, and rival prospectors won’t hesitate to take what you’ve found.

Out here, every decision matters. Push deeper into the unknown for richer veins, or turn back before the wilderness claims you.

In the end, the frontier decides who walks away with gold.
summary:
Fatal Frontier 1869 is a PC survival and prospecting game set in the unforgiving Alaskan wilderness of the 19th century, gaining attention for its unique real-money gold prospecting system.

Step into the boots of a pioneer and venture into dangerous, untamed territory in search of gold with real-world value. Every run is a calculated risk - face deadly wildlife, brutal conditions, and precision-based skill checks to secure your haul.

The deeper you push into the frontier, the richer the rewards - but the greater the danger. Succeed, and all the gold you find is yours to keep.
